bill_description: This bill would change U.S. labor law for workers who have newly formed a union. An employer would have to begin talks soon after the union asks. If the two sides cannot agree on a first contract, either side can ask a federal agency for mediation. If mediation does not produce an agreement, a three-person panel decides, and both sides must follow the panel’s decision for two years. The bill would also require current pay and working conditions to stay in place during talks and would keep an employer’s duty to bargain until workers remove the union in an election.
